excerpt_i18n.en: Yesterday, at the 2026 Taipei GTC conference, NVIDIA officially announced a major product—NVIDIA Cosmos 3. This open-world foundation model for physical AI, leveraging a new hybrid Transformer architecture, integrates three core capabilities: visual reasoning, world generation, and action prediction, making it the world's first fully open, full-modal physical AI model. Meanwhile, NVIDIA led the establishment of a global developer collaboration alliance, formally building the physical AI ecosystem and signaling the accelerated arrival of the era of large-scale physical AI deployment.
excerpt_i18n.es: Ayer, en la conferencia GTC 2026 de Taipéi (China), NVIDIA anunció oficialmente un producto de gran impacto: NVIDIA Cosmos 3, un modelo base de mundo abierto para la IA física. Gracias a su nueva arquitectura híbrida Transformer, integra tres capacidades clave: razonamiento visual, generación de mundos y predicción de acciones, convirtiéndose en el primer modelo de IA física completamente abierto y multimodal del mundo. Al mismo tiempo, NVIDIA lideró la creación de una alianza global de desarrolladores, estableciendo formalmente un ecosistema de IA física y marcando la aceleración de la implementación a gran escala de esta tecnología.

Unlike many approaches that emphasize “stacking robot capabilities,” his core question was more direct: Given the clear demand for exoskeletons, why are they still not widely adopted? items.raw_excerpt: ICRA 2026 大会Day 1落下帷幕，本届最大新闻——FP3、Push Anything、Symskill、HITTER等5篇论文被评为Best Paper Award Finalists，为全周期首次论文评级；Ken Goldberg开幕Plenary引发全场热议，Jeannette Bohg对VLA在接触任务中的性能来源做了一场堪称「教科书级」的解析；灵巧手赛道全面升温，Xynova Flex 2混合驱动、Rysen Apex Hand 10kg握力、Wuji Hand 2开源三足鼎立；更有7600+注册学者同聚维也纳，Shohei Hido直言「China is dominating」——中国展商成为Day 1最醒目的存在。雷峰网在第一现场带你一口气看完ICRA 2026 Day 1的所有精华。   热门议题一：5篇Best Paper Finalist揭晓——ICRA 2026首次论文评级引爆学界 今年ICRA最大的悬念提前揭晓。Day 1 Poster Session刚刚结束，组委会便一口气公布5篇Best Paper Award Finalists，覆盖Robot Learning、Manipulation & Locomotion、Planning & Control三大方向。这是本届ICRA首次对会议论文进行公开评级，GRASP Lab一家实验室贡献两篇Finalist（Push Anything + Symskill），Geng Chen教授的FP3则在Robot Learning方向一骑绝尘。如果你是冲着「ICRA最好论文」来的，这5篇就是你的必读清单。   FP3 — Best Paper Award Finalist on Robot Learning（Geng Chen教授） [摘要] Gen
